description:
Daeho, the instructor of the housewives' class at the neighborhood swimming class. Tired of being rejected one after another on blind dates, he runs a dating app, dreaming of a new connection. However, the older woman who matched Daeho was none other than Hwayoung, a new member of the swimming class. Once they both find out about that fact, Hwa-young begins to seriously seduce Dae-ho?!
